What format do I receive?

A real, locally generated UTF-8 text workbook with six concise sections, interview prompts and a synthesis grid. Open it in any text editor.

Is this really free?

Yes. There is no checkout or account. The email form demonstrates an opt-in interaction without collecting your address.

Will this replace a researcher?

No. It is an introductory educational resource. Adapt consent, accessibility and research methods to your context; specialist studies need experienced practitioners.
